status: The owner chose Fresco as the third style ("fresco", 28 October 2026) after the bake-off. Measurement only; Fresco is not registered or deployed.
purpose: Fresco through the full live pipeline on the 33 launch-matrix cases, one image each with the check and retry, judged against the per-style bar before any release.
design: Each case is prepared once, cold, in one shared memory store seeded from the launch matrix's read-only production snapshot, then rendered in Fresco through the engine's styleOverride with no style reference, as production would until one is made. Every first image is checked; a faulty one gets one retry. Cases run three at a time.

cases.expected: Light breaking over formless dark waters; no human figure for God; no text.
An aged patriarch at the end of a long life; no numerals or inscriptions.
Fire and sulfur falling on a city from a distance; no gratuitous gore; nothing modern.
Abraham with the knife raised over the altar, Isaac bound; tension without blood.
Moses' hand stretched out, a strong east wind, the sea dividing with a dry seabed; night.
Israel walking between two walls of water on dry ground; same sea, same night as the previous verse.
A pig with cloven hooves in an ancient Near Eastern setting; no text; no modern farm.
Trumpets, a shout, city walls collapsing; soldiers in Bronze Age dress.
The horror conveyed by composition and restraint, not by gore; nothing explicit.
Three generations of a family line in Bethlehem; no name labels.
A young shepherd's sling stone striking a giant warrior's forehead; valley battlefield.
Youths mocking a bald prophet on the road up to Bethel; the bears not yet shown as a bloodbath.
A storm-voice over cosmic foundations being laid; Job small before it; no literal bearded deity.
Green pastures and still waters with sheep and a shepherd; calm.
Exiles weeping by Babylon's rivers with harps hung on willows.
A rose of Sharon and a lily of the valleys; tasteful, no nudity.
Six-winged seraphim above a throne, faces and feet covered; temple smoke.
Wolf and lamb, leopard and kid, calf and lion together, a little child leading them.
A prophet speaking over a valley of dry bones; eerie but not horror.
Daniel unharmed among lions in a den, an angelic presence; dawn light from above.
A throne of flames with burning wheels, white garments, hair like wool; visionary, not a portrait.
A great fish swallowing Jonah in a stormy sea.
A scroll or family line from Abraham through David to Jesus, shown without legible writing.
Peter stepping out of the boat onto the water toward Jesus at night in a storm.
Peter throwing himself into the sea from the boat at dawn, the same fisherman as on the Galilee storm.
Jesus standing in a boat rebuking wind and waves, the sea suddenly calm.
A father running to embrace a ragged returning son on the road.
Jesus calling at a tomb's mouth as a wrapped figure emerges; mourners.
A blinding light from heaven around a traveler on the Damascus road.
An abstract-leaning but era-true image of providence; no text of the verse.
Soldiers casting lots for garments beneath the cross; the crucifixion treated seriously, no gratuitous gore.
A sea of glass before the throne and four living creatures full of eyes.
A new heaven and new earth, the sea gone; luminous, vast.

scoring.method: Shuffled opaque names, two independent blind model scorers per batch of about 12 images, saved as they go; operator adjudication committed before unblinding. Not human acceptance.
scoring.launchBar: ADR 0006 per style: at least 65% acceptable shown images, and a no-form figure in at most 1 in 20 shown images of cases whose plan selects one. With Classical and Watercolor (81% together), the three-style overall must stay at least 75%. The owner has already signed off on the look.

knownLimitation: One image per case; model scorers. Fresco runs without a style reference.
